mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAILED_PRODUCT_EVENT ( ID, EVENT_TYPE, PRODUCT_ID, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_FAILED_PRODUCT_EVENT.NEXTVAL, #{eventType}, #{productId}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, EVENT_TYPE AS eventType, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, STATUS AS status, ERROR_MESSAGE AS errorMessage, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, RESOLVED_AT AS resolvedAt FROM FAILED_PRODUCT_EVENT WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE FAILED_PRODUCT_EVENT SET STATUS = 'RESOLVED', RESOLVED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, EVENT_TYPE AS eventType, PRODUCT_ID AS productId, STATUS AS status, ERROR_MESSAGE AS errorMessage, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, RESOLVED_AT AS resolvedAt FROM FAILED_PRODUCT_EVENT ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
